acceptanceCriteria.text: No canonical in-memory Mottainai worker/AgentRun registry remains.
No duplicate persisted worker-supervision state remains as AgentRun truth.
Pi AgentSession lifecycle/event mapping no longer acts as Mottainai AgentRun authority.
WorkerRuntime lifecycle/control/observation contracts are removed or narrowed to non-authoritative compatibility projections with a demonstrated consumer.
Mottainai retains only orchestration state, policy, correlation, and required Tsukai profile/context construction.
Tsukai agentRunId remains the canonical execution reference.
Integration tests demonstrate assignment, observation, result, cancellation, retry correlation, and restart non-duplication through Tsukai.
The boundary Mottainai -> Tsukai -> Jinushi -> coding agent is proven where the environment permits.
Provider-backed or supervisor-dependent proof that cannot execute is recorded as ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED, never PASS.
Full repository verification and submitted-head CI are green.
PR evidence records exact Tsukai version, removed/retained ownership, API/profile mapping, Nawabari/Jinushi boundaries, retry/idempotency evidence, tests, certification, and CI/governance state.

issue.title: impl: remove duplicate AgentRun authority and certify Tsukai migration
